title: Comforting Cube Steaks
description: These oven-baked cube steaks in mushroom gravy are seasoned, then baked with cream of mushroom soup and lemon-lime soda for a comforting weeknight dinner.
ingredients: 0.5 teaspoon Cajun seasoning, or to taste
1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage
2 (10.75 ounce) cans condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (1 ounce) envelope dry onion soup mix

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.

Season steaks on both sides with Cajun seasoning and black pepper. Place steaks into the prepared baking dish. Pour lemon-lime beverage over steaks. Combine condensed soups and onion soup mix in a medium bowl; pour over steaks.

Bake, uncovered, in the preheated oven until meat reaches desired doneness, about 1 hour. Do not open the oven door during the first hour of cooking. An instant-read thermometer inserted into steak should read 145 degrees F (63 degrees C) for medium doneness. Serve steaks with gravy spooned over the top.
